      properties:
        type:

          title: Title

          example: NoResourceFoundException

          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true

          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"

        - message

The full test suite is green (`BUILD SUCCESS`), and the new acceptance test `coreFlagsPossibleDuplicate` passes. There's a single test class in this repo (`AcceptanceTest`); the other files under `acceptance/` are support base classes.

## Summary

I implemented soft-duplicate ("possible duplicate") detection for owner creation. When a new owner isn't a hard `identityKey` duplicate but shares an existing owner's `lastName` and `postcode` with a *different* telephone, it's still created and flagged with `possibleDuplicate: true` and `possibleDuplicateOf` set to the matching owner's id; otherwise `possibleDuplicate` is `false`.

Changes, each kept in its natural home:

- **`model/Owner.java`** — added a persisted `possible_duplicate_of` column with getter/setter, plus a derived transient `getPossibleDuplicate()` (`true` iff `possibleDuplicateOf != null`). This mirrors how other captured-at-creation fields (e.g. `bulkSignupWarning`, `namesakeCount`) are modeled.
- **`service/ClinicService[Impl].java`** — added `findPossibleDuplicateOf(Owner)`, a read-only query that returns the first existing owner matching last name (case-insensitively, reusing the existing `equalsIgnoreCase` helper) and postcode but with a different telephone, or `null` when the owner has no postcode / no match. This sits alongside the existing `findOwnersByIdentityKey` duplicate-detection query.
- **`rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — after the existing hard-duplicate check and before saving, it consults the service and sets `possibleDuplicateOf` on the new owner. The controller just orchestrates; detection logic stays in the service.
- **`resources/openapi.yml`** — added `possibleDuplicate` (boolean) and `possibleDuplicateOf` (int32) as read-only fields on the `Owner` schema, so the generated DTO carries them and MapStruct maps them by name automatically.

## Summary

I implemented soft-duplicate ("possible duplicate") detection for owner creation. When a new owner isn't a hard `identityKey` duplicate but shares an existing owner's `lastName` and `postcode` with a *different* telephone, it's still created and flagged with `possibleDuplicate: true` and `possibleDuplicateOf` set to the matching owner's id; otherwise `possibleDuplicate` is `false`.

Changes, each kept in its natural home:

- **`model/Owner.java`** — added a persisted `possible_duplicate_of` column with getter/setter, plus a derived transient `getPossibleDuplicate()` (`true` iff `possibleDuplicateOf != null`). This mirrors how other captured-at-creation fields (e.g. `bulkSignupWarning`, `namesakeCount`) are modeled.
- **`service/ClinicService[Impl].java`** — added `findPossibleDuplicateOf(Owner)`, a read-only query that returns the first existing owner matching last name (case-insensitively, reusing the existing `equalsIgnoreCase` helper) and postcode but with a different telephone, or `null` when the owner has no postcode / no match. This sits alongside the existing `findOwnersByIdentityKey` duplicate-detection query.
